status: historical preflight partially invalidated; causal callback claim superseded by verified R1 evidence
title: Shared-fault-history scheduling baseline harness preflight
purpose: Verify that immediate, fixed-delay, Lyons-Brown JIT, and offline scheduling paths consume one immutable record and one versioned inner-decoder callback before any performance or noisy-channel study.

branch_matrix.rule: invoke on the first current frontier at which a tracked cluster is visible
invoke one readout round after a tracked cluster first becomes visible
use the verified persistent cluster and active-nearest-absorber age gate; record defer/commit timing
invoke only after the full registered horizon; label every result noncausal

shared_contract.history: one immutable SpacetimeRecord and trial identifier per matched branch set
shared_contract.history_digest: one canonical digest over decoder-visible syndrome/herald readouts and expected known changes
shared_contract.private_sidecar: truth faults and logical scoring remain inaccessible to every schedule and inner-decoder request
shared_contract.prefix: causal branches receive only CausalRecordPrefix through their invocation round; offline alone receives the full horizon
shared_contract.clusters: one registered check-coordinate map, connectivity radius, persistent tracker semantics, and absorber geometry version
shared_contract.inner_decoder: one deterministic versioned callback object is shared by all four paths; the preflight may return a canonical token but no branch-specific physics
shared_contract.event_log: record branch, trial/history digest, causal horizon, persistent cluster ID, action, and inner-decoder request/response digest

invariants: all four branches bind to the same trial and full-history digest
causal branches cannot access detector or herald rows after their invocation horizon
offline access is explicit and every offline output is labelled noncausal
the same inner-decoder version and implementation digest serves every branch
schedule-specific timing may change requests but cannot change the underlying record
simulation truth and logical scoring never enter a schedule or decoder request
all four branches produce deterministic invocation logs on the bounded fixtures

verified_cases: all four registered branches execute through one public runner at their expected invocation rounds
all branches share one visible-history digest and one decoder version/implementation digest
causal requests stop at invocation while offline is explicitly marked noncausal
inner-decoder requests expose no truth, fault, or logical-scoring fields
visible-history identity is invariant under different private truth/fault decompositions producing the same readouts
full deterministic replay is bit identical
missing trial identity or active JIT absorber is rejected

invalidation.cause: causal callback requests contain the full visible-history digest and are future-sensitive
invalidation.remediation_status: R1 verified at manifests/j2-r1-causal-callback-remediation-2026-08-29.json; this original artifact remains historical and is not retroactively rehabilitated

acceptance_items.item: Implement immutable history/request digests and a truth-free versioned inner-decoder callback protocol.
Implement all four registered scheduling branches through one public runner.
Verify matched history, causal truncation, explicit offline access, fixed delay, JIT deferral, and deterministic replay on bounded fixtures.
acceptance_items.status: original evidence invalidated; replaced by verified R1 counterfactual

acceptance_items.item: Report the preflight without performance, noisy-channel, threshold, or fault-tolerance interpretation.

claim_boundary: This contract authorizes only a deterministic harness preflight. It does not authorize noisy sampling, compare logical failure rates, validate a physical D(S3) or D4 inner decoder, or establish schedule advantage, threshold, or fault tolerance.
next_gate: Implement I1 round-local E1 record derivation; typed mode/schedule integration and sampling remain blocked.
